<translate>
The '''GT Saga''' is one of the two sagas that follow the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]]. It opens, together with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], once you complete every quest of the Buu Saga, and covers the Black Star Dragon Ball hunt on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]], Baby, Super 17 and the Shadow Dragons. Its fights take you across [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], Namek, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]].
</translate>

<translate>
The GT Saga and the Daima Saga can be played in any order.
</translate>

<translate>

<translate>
== Notes ==
</translate>
<translate>
* Quest 2, ''Parts for Bulma'', trades a [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Saiyan Space Pod]] and other parts for a [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]] (Earth).
* Quest 31, ''The Cracked Dragon Balls'', asks you to summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] with the seven Earth Dragon Balls.
* Completing quest 30, ''Super 17 Returns'', opens the three Hirudegarn quests of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] (if the Daima Saga has not opened them already).
* Quest 18 sends you to [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]] on the Sacred Kai Planet.
* On Hard, Lord Luud, Hyper Meta-Rilldo, Super Baby Vegeta 2, Golden Great Ape Baby, Super 17 and Omega Shenron use the Expert AI tier.
</translate>
